lines.zh: 我站在这，脚底没动过一寸。
lines.en: I stand here; my feet have not moved an inch.

lines.zh: 别人走来走去，我留在原地。
lines.en: Others walk about; I stay put.

lines.zh: 地板上的印子是我压出来的。
lines.en: The dent in the floor is from my weight.
My pose has never changed.

lines.zh: 我没有走过去，是你们走过来。
lines.en: I did not walk over; you walked to me.

lines.zh: 我的脚底和地板贴在一起了。
lines.en: My soles have fused to the floor.
Time goes around me.

lines.zh: 我站得太久，灰落了一层。
lines.en: I have stood so long that dust has settled.

lines.zh: 我旁边的椅子被搬走又搬回来。
lines.en: The chair beside me is moved away and back.
I do not want to move, and I cannot.

lines.zh: 我从这头看到那头，脚没动。
lines.en: I look from one end to the other without a step.

lines.zh: 我的影子一直朝着同一个方向。
lines.en: My shadow has never turned.
I sit with my hands on my knees.
I do not blink, because I cannot.
Dust settles on my shoulders.
I hear the clock ticking.
I count the people who pass.

lines.zh: 我的嘴角一直是那个弧度。
lines.en: My mouth keeps the same curve.

lines.zh: 有人在擦我，然后又走开。
lines.en: Someone wipes me and walks away.

lines.zh: 这里很静，静得能听见灯。
lines.en: It is quiet enough to hear the lights.
I do not need to breathe.

lines.zh: 夜晚来的时候，我还在这。
lines.en: When night comes, I am still here.
You have come to stand before me.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛对着门的方向。
lines.en: My eyes are fixed on the door.

lines.zh: 你是不是以为我在看你？
lines.en: Do you think I am looking at you?
I do not turn my head.
You have stood beside me a long time.
Did you say something to me?
I cannot answer.

lines.zh: 我的脸一直是这个样子。
lines.en: My face has always been this way.

lines.zh: 你退开一点，光会好一些。
lines.en: Step back and the light improves.

lines.zh: 你手放在我肩上，又拿开了。
lines.en: You put a hand on my shoulder, then took it away.
Staring like this, you lose.

lines.zh: 我什么都记得，只是不说。
lines.en: I remember everything; I just do not say it.
You wave a hand before my eyes.
I do not react, and that frightens you more.
You carry a smell I know.

lines.zh: 门那边有人叫你，你没听见。
lines.en: Someone calls you from the door; you do not hear.
You laugh, and it does not sound right.

lines.zh: 我一直在你身后那个位置。
lines.en: I have always been at that spot behind you.
A piece of shell falls off.
My hair is askew.
I make no sound.
My eyes are still open.
Dust falls from my shoulder.
I settle slowly back.
A crack opens on me.
I keep the original angle.
Holding it before me changes nothing.
My jaw is fixed.
I can neither eat nor reach.
Try setting it in my hand.
It fell at my feet.
You need not feed me.
I look at it, nothing more.

lines.zh: 你在跟一个摆设讲道理。
lines.en: You are reasoning with a decoration.
You take it away and I do not react.
Is this your kindness?
You bump me and I am still standing there.
Your shoulder meets my arm.
I am hard as a length of wood.
You back off; I do not follow.
I stood in place all night.

lines.zh: 这具身体的重量比你大。
lines.en: This body weighs more than you.
I do not even rock.

lines.zh: 你把灰尘从我身上蹭掉了。
lines.en: You brushed some dust off me.
You bump again; I am still here.
The spot beside me is empty.
There used to be another here.

lines.zh: 我们并排坐着，都不说话。
lines.en: We sat side by side in silence.
It was carried away; I remain.

lines.zh: 我对着空位看了一整夜。
lines.en: I looked at the empty place all night.
No one came to fill it.
I cannot even turn my head toward it.
I keep that name.
The light goes out and I keep sitting.

lines.zh: 我很孤单，但我说不出来。
lines.en: I am lonely, but I cannot say it.
Something fell at my feet.
I cannot pick it up.
I stared at it all day.
Someone took it away for me.
I remember where it lay.
My fingers are an inch from it.
I wait for someone to bend down.
It was swept away.
There is nothing I can do.
I look at the empty spot.
I do not strike back.
My eyes still face the door.
Can you fight a decoration?
My head has not turned.
You hit harder and faster.
I do not dodge, and I cannot.
Pieces fall off me.
I am looking somewhere else.
You receive no answer.
Sooner or later you will stop.
I am still seated where I was.

lines.zh: 十点血的玩偶，也看着你。
lines.en: A ten-hit-point doll is watching you too.
The curve of my mouth has not changed.

lines.zh: 你开始怀疑我是不是活的。
lines.en: You begin to wonder if I am alive.
You circle the room.
I sit, still facing the door.
You go behind me to look.
My eyes do not follow you.
You try to push me.
I rock once and settle back.
The longer you look, the uneasier you get.
My hands remain on my knees.
Did you hear something?
There is only the clock here.
You retreat to the doorway again.
My position has not changed.
You look back three times.
I have not followed.
You dare not turn your back.
You even quiet your breathing.
The light moves onto my face.
You count the time.
Nor did I hit you.
You finish; I am still seated.
My hands hang by my knees.
Your fist lands on my chest.
There is only a dull thud.
One of my eyes cracks.
You wait for me to strike back.
You fall back two steps.
I don't move; I just sit here.
You lower your fist.
My head is still at that angle.
You hear your own heartbeat.
The quiet is unbearable.
I have always been in this building.

lines.zh: 有人把我搬到这个位置。
lines.en: Someone set me in this spot.

lines.zh: 我的脚落在地板上，就没再抬起来。
lines.en: My feet touched the floor and never lifted again.
When the lights came on, I faced the door.
The dust has not yet covered me.

lines.zh: 我被摆在这里，作为展示。
lines.en: I was placed here for display.

lines.zh: 路过的孩子看了我一眼。
lines.en: A passing child glanced at me.

lines.zh: 这层楼多了一个不会动的东西。
lines.en: This floor gained one thing that does not move.
I was taken out of a crate.
Someone else chose my place.

lines.zh: 我坐下的那一刻，钟响了。
lines.en: The clock struck as I was seated.
The door opens and someone enters.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里露出半张脸。
lines.en: Half my face shows from the shadow.

lines.zh: 这间屋子从此不太一样。
lines.en: This room has not been the same since.
My eyes point at the doorway.

lines.zh: 灯照到我时，光暗了一块。
lines.en: Where the light reaches me, it dims.
An empty place remains beside me.
I brought nothing with me.
The plastic melts and the smell is sharp.
I topple, and I do not get up.
Water swells my stuffing.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我脸朝下躺着。
lines.en: The blast flips me and I lie face down.

lines.zh: 一箭钉进我的胸口，我仍坐着。
lines.en: An arrow pins my chest and I still sit.

lines.zh: 光扫过我，我的眼睛亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Light sweeps me and my eyes flare once.
I cannot starve; I only gather dust.

lines.zh: 雷过身，我的关节跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning passes and one joint jerks.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，连姿势都没改。
lines.en: I fall, and my pose never changes.
